summary: Phase 2 testing complete for ACTOOS ONE - Favorites and Rating System. All features working correctly: Heart button on restaurant cards, favorites toggle (red when active), 'Mes favoris' button in Profile with count badge, Favorites screen with 'Retirer' option and confirmation dialog, localStorage persistence. RatingSystem component verified in code review.

issues: HTML validation warning: Nested button (favorite button inside restaurant card button) causes React hydration warning. Consider using div with role='button' for outer container.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix nested button issue in RestaurantCard.jsx - change outer <button> to <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> to avoid HTML validation warning
critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantCard.jsx line 18-23: Outer element is <button> but contains another <button> for favorites (line 58-69). This violates HTML spec and causes React hydration warning. Recommend changing outer element to <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick={...}>
